text:
marta: kicking off preflight for the 10:00-11:00 microwindow. tagging api/runtime/console/router owners — want to lock down pins and rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: wave scheduled. pinned variants: runtime=v2.3.1, api=v1.9.0, console=v3.0.2, router=v5.12.0. canary plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> full.

ryan: quick note — router change is only header propagation fix (no schema), should be low risk.

sophie: console includes metrics-schema opt-in. default stays same, but new telemetry collectors enabled under flag: telemetry.v3. I'll add steps to release notes. :memo:

zane: runtime needs small kv-eviction tweak to avoid noisy GC on short seqs. I'll apply config at T-5. Plan: patch ConfigMap then rolling-restart runtime pods with drain.

kevin: proposing rollback thresholds: 1) p95 latency +500ms sustained over 5m OR 2) error rate >1% sustained 5m OR 3) token cost regression >8% in Canary window. If any trigger hit, we immediately cut canary and route to previous pinned runtime variant.

marta: agree on thresholds. add operational play: deploy-bot should auto-hold progression and notify eng-oncall and SRE. Also need explicit unpin for router only if console depends fail.

deploy-bot: pinned variants recorded in release metadata. Auto-fallback policy enabled: on rollback signal -> revert runtime to pinned v2.3.0 and divert 100% traffic after manual ack. Canary progression automated but will stop on alerts.

ryan: question — if console fails while router is green, do we unpin router? That could cause header mismatch.

marta: good call. decision: console rollback first. hold router pin (do not touch) unless router shows degraded telemetry after console rollback; only then consider router unpin. Documenting dependency matrix in release notes.

sophie: adding console rollback steps to notes: 1) set console flag telemetry.v3=false 2) scale down console replicas gradually 3) route console traffic to previous variant. I'll paste the commands.

sophie: ```bash
kubectl set env deploy/console TELEMETRY_V3=false -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/console -n prod
```

zane: applying KV param change now — running: `kubectl apply -f runtime-kv-tweak.yaml -n inference` then `kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n inference`. I'll post status.

zane: rollout progressing, pods restarting one-by-one, no crashloops in logs (quick grep).

kevin: monitoring: created canary dashboards and alert rules (p95, 99, error %, token unit cost). Alert channels -> #eng-oncall and pager.

devex-bot: dry-run smoke tests passed for API and runtime (integration suite v1.2). Full e2e scheduled at T-10.

marta: ok, final checks: docs updated? sophie: yes. migration steps included.

ryan: +1 from router side, will keep a close eye on header propagation traces.

zane: runtime change finished, health ok. logs show reduced GC spikes.

deploy-bot: canary started at 10:02. 5% traffic to new variants. will report back at 10:12 for progression.

kevin: setting watch: p95, errors, token-cost heatmap. will abort if thresholds tripped.

marta: tagging eng-oncall: @ryan @sophie @zane — please monitor your dashboards. escalation plan in runbook pinned to the release. :thumbsup:

sophie: noted. if anything weird, we'll cut console and hold.

ryan: seeing slight p95 bump (+120ms) at 10:06, still under threshold. watching.

deploy-bot: canary progressed to 25% at 10:18 (no alerts). next hold window 15m.

kevin: no error-rate spike. cost regression within 3%.

marta: unless other objections, proceed to full rollout at end of hold. leave rollback steps ready.

sophie: release notes final, added rollback checklist and dependency matrix.

ryan: +1. good job team.

deploy-bot: full rollout complete at 10:40. All services at pinned variants. Please close the window when post-release check OK.

marta: post-release check after 10:50: all metrics nominal, will archive release and notify product. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
